title: PFB-Style AEAD with Early Plaintext Release
summary: The source states security for PFB Plus and PFBω when unverified plaintext is not released and nonces are not repeated; security when plaintext may be released before verification remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Construct or prove a PFB-style AEAD secure when decryption may release plaintext before tag verification.

scope.domain: Authenticated-encryption mode security for PFB-style constructions.
parameters: PFB Plus and PFBω (the AEAD modes under discussion)
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct or prove security for a PFB-style AEAD when decryption may release plaintext before tag verification.

citations.label: Lightweight Authenticated Encryption Mode Suitable for Threshold Implementation

progress.summary: The source gives PFB Plus and PFBω a conditional security statement requiring no unverified plaintext release and no nonce repetition. It also states that misuse security is not ensured; the row frames the missing early-release guarantee as a construction-or-proof task.
citation_labels: Yusuke Naito et al., Lightweight Authenticated Encryption Mode Suitable for Threshold Implementation
